liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Race Is On** (2 reviews): The Race Is On is played nice and tight, with Phil praised; Reviewer finds Vince's solo in The Race Is On plodding and noisy, stepping on the other players [13][15]
- **Row Jimmy** (2 reviews): The jam in Row Jimmy is singled out as sublime; Agrees with an earlier reviewer that Row Jimmy stands out [11][13]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Bobby mixes up the verses in Hell In A Bucket [21]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): New Speedway Boogie is called a highlight [20]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): The Music Never Stopped closes the first set in scorching fashion [21]
- **Victim Or The Crime** (1 review): Victim Or The Crime opens the second set with a spooky feel [21]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): A nice jam leads from Victim Or The Crime into Crazy Fingers [20]
- **Drums** (1 review): The drum solo is praised as rocking [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-05-04.113100.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 160 min [1]
- **gd91-05-04.sbd.ladner.9117.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: The soundboard mix is described as nice; Keyboards and their vocals are low in the mix, Jerry may be slightly low, and Phil's bass is loud [13][17]
- **gd1991-05-04.150676.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 176 min [4]
- **gd1991-05-04.at853.lech.116894.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 176 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Recording levels are low with typical dropouts in the first half of set one, then improves [19]

## Around the show

- The reviewer sees the May 1991 West Coast shows as a key bridge between spring and summer 1991 [12]
- Reviewer liked this show more than the 3 May 1991 show [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-05-04.113100.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: Source: 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones (up front-center) > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [1]
- **gd91-05-04.sbd.ladner.9117.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > C > DAT > CDR [2]
- **gd1991-05-04.150676.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 3, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: Several masters were combined to make the show complete; files are 16-bit, 44.1 kHz [4]
- **gd1991-05-04.at853.lech.116894.flac16**: taped by John Lech; transferred by Jeff Bowen;Brad Foster; source: Source: (FOB) AT853a [cardioids/xy] > Panasonic SV-255; [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1991-05-04 Cal Expo, Sacramento, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-05-04-cal-expo-sacramento-ca-usa/) [23]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1991-05-04 Sat Cal Expo Amphitheatre, Sacramento, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1262149173061/grateful-dead-1991-05-04-sat-cal-expo) [24]
